name: DropLink 0.1.0
body_html:
DropLink 0.1.0: first launch 🚀

DropLink sends files, folders and text straight from one device to another, over your local network or across the internet. No server ever stores your files: they travel encrypted from your device to the other one.

What's in it

  • Radar. Devices on your network show up by themselves. Pick one and drop files, a folder or your clipboard into the docking bay.
  • Rooms across networks. Share a short room code (or a droplink:// link) to connect two devices on different networks. They connect directly with WebRTC.
  • End-to-end encrypted. Each transfer is encrypted between the two devices. Both screens show the same short code (SAS) so you can check that nobody is in the middle.
  • You decide. Incoming cargo waits for your OK. Trust a device once to let its transfers start without asking. If the sender cancels or goes away, the offer closes at once.
  • Resumes after drops. A broken link picks up where it stopped, and every file is checked with SHA-256 on arrival.
  • Light on your machine. The transfer engine streams everything in small chunks, runs under 64 MiB of memory, and the animated pixel UI pauses when you're not looking.
  • Three console themes. Cyan Nebula, Amber Terminal and Magenta Void, all original pixel art.

Install

Windows 10/11 (x64). Download droplink-0.1.0-windows-x64-setup.exe below and run it. It installs for you alone, with no administrator rights, and follows Windows' light or dark mode.

Linux (x86_64). Pick the package for your distro:

Distro File Install
Debian, Ubuntu, Mint, Pop!_OS droplink-0.1.0-linux-amd64.deb sudo apt install ./droplink-0.1.0-linux-amd64.deb
Fedora, RHEL, openSUSE droplink-0.1.0-linux-amd64.rpm sudo dnf install ./droplink-0.1.0-linux-amd64.rpm
Arch, Manjaro, EndeavourOS droplink-bin-0.1.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst sudo pacman -U ./droplink-bin-0.1.0-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
Any other distro droplink-0.1.0-linux-amd64.AppImage chmod +x droplink-0.1.0-linux-amd64.AppImage, then run it

To build the Arch package yourself, save droplink-bin.PKGBUILD as PKGBUILD and run makepkg -si.

macOS. No build yet.

Updates

On Windows, DropLink checks this page at start (you can switch that off in CONFIG → UPDATES) and offers new versions. It only runs an installer whose SHA-256 matches the signed latest.json, and whose Ed25519 signature matches the release key built into the app. On Linux, install new releases yourself for now.

Known limits

  • WebRTC across very strict networks (symmetric NAT on both sides) may need a TURN relay, which is not set up yet.
  • Self-update is Windows-only.

Feedback and bug reports: open an issue.
